additional_info.subject: ID0390207-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / P3 170000443] Black display CRM:00642001799
additional_info.body:
Hello Sebastien,
I trust this email finds you in good health. We have received a technical support request from
Siemens SAS
in your region regarding the following product:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
MP / P3 170000443
Charger ID/Serial No.:
0n5SVJ
Problem Description:
Black display
JFYI-
Regarding the reported issue, we understand that the HMI screen is black, and you stated that the supply voltage did not check.
So, site intervention should be planned to inspect the connections, as there may be a loose connection between KF1 and PH2. Please ensure that the DPP and USB connections used for the OC display and touch functionality are properly checked. And kindly check the supply voltage 24v as well.
Additionally, there is a possibility that the DPP or USB cable may be faulty. We recommend swapping them with working cables to confirm. If the issue persists after these checks, the screen will need to be replaced.
During the site visit, please bring a spare HMI, DPP, and USB cable in case replacements are necessary.
Kindly refer to the marked HMI schematic below, and also review the attached Q-feedback for troubleshooting.
https://support.industry.siemens.com/cs/document/109816666/si-e-q-feedback-q2302-sicharge-d-hmi-backlight-off-and-scrambled-image-due-to-router-emissions?dti=0&lc=en-WW
Please note, if the charger's DLogic is Gen2, then Q-feedback process will not apply.
if all the check point has been verified and still the problem persists then need to plan for HMI replacement.
Please refer the below parts for replacement if needed,
Upon reviewing our asset database, we found that the product is no longer under warranty since 03/07/2024, as a result, we are transferring the case to the regional queue.
Kindly communicate with the customer and provide the necessary service support and/or offer. We have already informed the customer that a regional representative will be in touch shortly.
Should you require further remote or expert support, please order it via PMD.
For additional information, please visit the Service Collaboration SharePoint. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Mohini Patil
Please do not change the subject of this Email when replying to it
